subject: Television & Streaming
title: Superhero TV Saturation
description: A fast breakdown of Superhero TV Saturation for builders.

hook.text: Marvel launched WandaVision, Loki, and five other shows on Disney+ in two years. Even fans felt overwhelmed.

buildup.text: Superhero TV exploded when Marvel and DC realized streaming could extend their cinematic universes indefinitely.

discovery.text: The Boys on Amazon flipped the genre—superheroes were corrupt, violent, and corporate.

twist.text: Audiences began skipping MCU shows. Viewership dropped with each new series. The franchise felt like homework.

climax.text: Superhero fatigue became real. The genre that dominated entertainment for a decade started showing cracks.

quiz.question: What does 'superhero fatigue' refer to?
options: Actors getting tired of superhero roles
Audience exhaustion from too much superhero content
